motivation: Current independently audited closed ledger is unavailable because creator temporary directory normal read returned PermissionError. Parent report usage is not an independent closed-ledger read. Preserve that limitation; do not reconstruct or repair current receipts.
scope: Future fresh source revision only, after active campaign terminal and review. Never modify ACLs, bypass ownership, probe credentials, copy private env, or alter active files.
mechanism: Before any future API request, the creating solver chooses an explicit owned persistent run directory outside creator-only temporary directories and records a relative run identity. The path is validated inside that run root; no arbitrary user path or symlink traversal.

Creator writes a sanitized usage journal in this persistent directory as logical authorization and each HTTP attempt finish. Atomic temporary files are created in the destination parent and replaced there using exact UTF8 bytes, not moved out of a restricted creator temp directory.

RunBudget exit records its real final status/deadline/elapsed and atomically exports api-usage.closed.json before solver termination. Closed is a state transition, not an inferred snapshot of report.json. Export failure is explicit and prevents independent API qualification.

Export only public-safe counts and identifiers: relative job/run IDs, source/plan hashes, ordered logical events, purposes, requested model/reasoning, reported response alias, finish/error category, integer reported tokens and known HTTP attempts, usage completeness. Never key/header/env/prompt/response bodies/URL credentials.

Incomplete usage, unreported retries, crash or midrequest termination remain null/unknown with usage_complete=false. Logical requests, wire attempts, model-side generation tokens and parser validation statuses are separate; provider success with parser failure still consumes the request slot.

Write a hash/byte-length receipt for the exact exported bytes; supervisor independently reads it normally and checks schema, closed status, event ordering, aggregate arithmetic, request caps and hash agreement with the model report. Keep original creator trace immutable as a separate source.

Before launching model experiments in that future revision, a small synthetic creator-to-independent-reader probe establishes ordinary read availability without permissions changes, secret data or API calls. If unreadable, fail the qualification gate before ML.
Independent readable export verifies saved local accounting; it is not provider-side billing proof or a team budget/balance estimate. External coordinator clock/process observations remain necessary.
future_nofit_checks: UTF8 LF/CRLF exact persisted byte hash roundtrip
request success plus parser failure consumes one logical slot
creator crash cannot fabricate completed closed receipt
ordinary independent reader can open persistent export without ACL changes
atomic export failure fails qualification while preserving original trace
aggregate event counts match caps and no cumulative nested snapshots are summed
proposed_gate_change: Future independent procedure gate requires readable valid closed export; parent-reported usage remains separately labeled and cannot substitute.
